criteria.note: A new NON-LLM bridge module .warp/tracker_bridge.py: reconcile_drafts(adapter, config, store, owner) is pure control logic over the injected WARP-0603 adapter seam and an injected SpecStore. For each candidate with no existing spec it runs the SHIPPED intake draft_spec_from_item (tracker_intake.py, a pure dict builder with _fm_safe front-matter sanitization, no network/no file write) to produce a status:draft warp.spec/v1 bound to the resolved repo, rendered by render_spec_markdown and written via store.write_spec. The candidate rule draft_candidate is the two-leg pre-approval subset of the eligibility triple: assignee == config 'agent' AND resolve_repo (reused WARP-0601, fail-closed by name) yields one repo, INDEPENDENT of the ready status. Imports are stdlib only (argparse, collections, importlib.util, json, sys, pathlib) plus importlib-loaded local WARP modules (tracker.py, tracker_intake.py, validate.py, tracker_adapter.py); no subprocess, no agent/LLM, no network. Selftest confirms the written draft is a valid warp.spec/v1 (V.check_spec == 0) with status: draft, tracker_repo: repo-a, item: CAND, and that draft_candidate is the pre-approval subset (a non-ready Agent+repo ticket is a draft_candidate True while is_eligible is False; at the ready status is_eligible flips True - the WARP-1003 promote leg).

The bridge is a RECONCILER idempotent by the durable intake_source link, not a processed-offset ledger or a side store. store.spec_id_for_source(repo, source) is the single idempotency oracle, keyed on source = (item.tracker default 'jira', item.id) - the SAME link draft_spec_from_item records in front matter. A ticket whose spec already exists is not redrafted; the keyed surface comment dedups; a ticket listed twice in one batch is collapsed by the same guard. The reference FilesystemSpecStore reads intake_source back off disk with parse_yamlish (the nested-map reader, since front_matter would collapse the nested map), so the link is a real durable oracle, not only the fake. TEETH PROVEN REAL by mutation: forcing spec_id = None in reconcile_drafts (break the already-drafted oracle -> always re-draft) turned FOUR WARP-1002 idempotency cases RED (replay-no-new-draft, replay-byte-identical, intra-batch-duplicate-collapse, FilesystemSpecStore-persisted-link) at 1403 passed / 4 failed; git checkout reverted, git diff --quiet clean, HEAD unchanged at f6e1b9e, selftest back to 1407/0.

Two-stage (PLAN-0010 D1, 2-stage): after drafting, the bridge posts the drafted spec back on the ticket as a KEYED comment adapter.comment(iid, body, key=_comment_key(source)) where the key is warp-draft:<tracker>:<item>, so it posts at most once (FakeTracker._comment dedups by key, returning False on a repeat). The comment body carries the drafted spec plus the plain instruction that a draft is NOT claimable until the human moves the ticket to the ready-for-dev status and assigns the Agent user. The bridge NEVER promotes: no set_status, no status write anywhere; the drafted front matter is status: draft. Selftest asserts exactly one keyed comment after the first pass and no new comment on replay; no transition is emitted on the candidate.

Teeth are real and non-tautological. The gate drives the offline FakeTracker + FakeSpecStore: the candidate drafts and is surfaced exactly once, while three single-leg negatives each produce NO draft and NO comment with the adapter receiving ZERO writes (writes() == []): a non-Agent/unassigned ticket, and a ticket with no resolvable repo; the already-drafted leg (replay) produces no new draft/comment. Each leg is proven non-vacuous - restoring the Agent assignee, or restoring a resolvable repo tag, or drafting into a fresh store, each makes the SAME ticket draft. draft_candidate is asserted pure (config and ticket byte-unchanged) and fails closed on a non-dict/None without raising. No live network in the gate; the live Jira and FilesystemSpecStore paths are the same reference-wired shape used elsewhere.

findings.text: Non-blocking, carried from the WARP-1001 review. draft_candidate catches only TrackerRoutingError around resolve_repo (line 109-112), mirroring is_eligible. A hand-constructed unvalidated malformed config (for example mechanism 'label' with no 'label_prefix') could make _routing_candidates raise KeyError/TypeError, which would propagate out of draft_candidate rather than fail closed. This is out of contract: config always arrives from load_tracker_config, whose _validate (WARP-1001 AC1) rejects such a shape on load, so the shipped path is total and fail-closed. Recorded only as an adversarial edge; a future hardening could widen the except to (TrackerRoutingError, TrackerConfigError, KeyError, TypeError) at the resolve_repo call so draft_candidate is total even on an unvalidated config.

summary: WARP-1002 (the inbound bridge, draft stage, W2 of PLAN-0010) passes with notes at f6e1b9e, zero blocking findings.
